display_name: The Martyrs of the Lavra of Saint Sabbas

names.form: Cuvioșii Mucenici din Mănăstirea Sfântului Sava cel Sfințit
names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 20 martie.

Read out of saint.gr's line for 20 Μαρτίου, «Άγιοι Αββάδες εν τη μονή του Αγίου Σάββα αναιρεθέντες, των λεγομένων Μαύρων», with the rank word left off — the company's own name on the Greek calendar, the Abbades, those called the Black.

names.form: Иоанн, Сергий, Патрикий и прочие в обители святого Саввы убиенные
names.note: The title of the life page behind the day's three name links, which is the only form this calendar gives the company as a company; the day's own line declines all of it, «Прпп. Иоанна, Сергия, Патрикия и прочих, во обители св. Саввы убиенных». The three name pages — 1012, 1976 and 1748 — give three individual nominatives instead, «Иоанн Савваит», «Сергий Савваит» and «Патрикий Савваит», and none of those is stored here, because this folder is not any one of the three men. Each of the three name pages lists 20 марта and no other day.

death.note: The year days.pravoslavie.ru closes its line for 20 марта ст. ст. with, «(796)», and the only year any page read for this folder gives the killing. The folder previously held 780–797, which was not a year of death at all but the reign doxologia.ro's life prints — «iar în Constantinopol împărățind Constantin și Irina (780-797)» — that page explicitly giving no year for the killing, only that it fell on 20 March, Great Thursday. 796 lies inside that reign and the two readings do not conflict. This calendar's own life gives no year in its text either, only the two days 13 and 20 марта and the Great Thursday.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 20 марта ст. ст. — «Прпп. Иоанна, Сергия, Патрикия и прочих, во обители св. Саввы убиенных (796).»

attestations.note: **The corpus holds this company as one folder and this row keeps it one.** The line names three of the dead and then «и прочих», the rest, and its three name links go to three nominatives of the calendar's own making, «Иоанн Савваит», «Сергий Савваит» and «Патрикий Савваит». The standing ruling is that a synaxis which enumerates its members is one folder per member and one that names nobody is one entry; this line is neither — it names three out of a company its own reading counts as thirteen shot in the first raid and eighteen suffocated in the cave, so it is a heading with three names in it and not an enumeration. The romanian, greek and serbian rows already on this folder read the same day the same way. No folder is therefore made for any of the three, and the three names are said in the life, which is where the reading puts them. The year is narrowed: the line closes «(796)», which is the first year any page read for this folder has given the killing, and it falls inside the reign the folder already held. The reading adds the two raids a week apart, the ransom of four thousand gold pieces, the fire of dung before the cave and the end of the raiders. The day page prints a kondak for the company, which is copied here.

source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul zilei pentru 20 martie — «Sfinții Cuvioși Mucenici din Mănăstirea Sfântului Sava cel Sfințit»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 20ης Μαρτίου — «Άγιοι Αββάδες εν τη μονή του Αγίου Σάββα αναιρεθέντες, των λεγομένων Μαύρων»

attestations.note: «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 20 Μαρτίου εκάστου έτους.» Two things on this page do not agree with what the corpus already holds, and neither has been resolved in the row. It puts the raid «Στα χρόνια του Ηρακλείου (620 - 641 μ.Χ.)», in the reign of Heraclius, where doxologia's life put it under the patriarch Elias II with Constantine and Irene reigning (780–797), which is the interval the corpus's dates field carries; that field has not been touched. And it makes the fathers forty-four, «(44 κατά την παράδοση)», by tradition. It names the two accounts it rests on — Stephen the Sabbaite, kept on 13 Ιουλίου, nephew of John of Damascus, and Antiochus Pandectes, kept on 24 Δεκεμβρίου — says Theoctistus is mentioned among the Abbades, and adds that the memory of these venerable-martyrs is repeated on 16 Μαΐου, which is a second Greek day and a note rather than a second row.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 02.04.2026 (20. март ст. ст.) — „Преподобни мученици Јован и други.“

attestations.note: The day's first entry, on the same menologion day the Romanian and the Greek already keep in this folder, and the same company: the monks of the monastery of Saint Sabbas the Sanctified near Jerusalem, killed by Arabs who shot some with arrows and smothered the rest with smoke in the cave of Saint Sabbas. **The Prologue takes doxologia's side of the disagreement recorded in this folder's Greek row**, and that is the most useful thing in the entry: it puts the raid in the reign of Constantine and Irene with Elias patriarch of Jerusalem, exactly as doxologia's life did, and nowhere near the reign of Heraclius that saint.gr prints. It dates it before Pascha 796, which falls inside the 780–797 this folder already holds; a sourced interval is not narrowed on a reading, so no date was touched. The entry names the abbot Thomas, whose words to the brethren it quotes, and says the raiders quarrelled on the way back to their tents and killed one another to the last man, also in 796. **No Serbian name form was stored.** The heading is „Преподобни мученици Јован и други“ — one forename and then the others, naming nobody else — and the corpus holds no folder for a John of this company, so that heading is neither a name for the company nor a form for any one man, and composing one would be writing what the page does not print. No new folder was made for that John either: the other two calendars fold every member into this one company folder, and splitting one man out of it on a forename is not a reading a reader should make alone. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

hymns.text: Mucenicii Tăi, Doamne, întru nevoinţele lor, cununile nesctricăciunii au dobândit de la Tine, Dumnezeul nostru. Că având tăria Ta, pe chinuitori au învins; zdrobit-au şi ale demonilor neputincioase îndrăzniri. Pentru rugăciunile lor, mântuieşte sufletele noastre, Hristoase Dumnezeule.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfinţilor Cuvioşi Mucenici din Mănăstirea Sfântului Sava cel Sfinţit

english.text: Thy martyrs, O Lord, in their contest received crowns of incorruption from Thee, our God; for having Thy strength, they cast down the tormentors and broke the feeble insolence of the demons. At their prayers, O Christ God, save our souls.

hymns.text: Ὡς τοῦ Σωτῆρος ἁγιόλεκτοι ἄρνες, ἐξωρμημένοι ἐκ χωρῶν διαφόρων, τῇ Ποίμνῃ συνεδράμετε Σάββα τοῦ σοφοῦ· ὅθεν θανατούμενοι, ἀπηνείᾳ βαρβάρων, χαίροντες ἀνήλθετε, πρὸς οὐράνιον μάνδραν, καθάπερ Ὅσιοι καί Ἀθληταί, ἐκδυσωποῦντες, ὑπέρ τῶν ψυχῶν ἡμῶν.

source.text: saint.gr — Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος δ’, Ὃ ὑψωθεῖς ἐν τῷ Σταυρῷ, on the page of Άγιοι Αββάδες εν τη μονή του Αγίου Σάββα αναιρεθέντες. This is the proper: it names the flock of wise Sabbas and the cruelty of the barbarians. The page prints a second apolytikion, Ἦχος β’ «Ἀθλοφόροι Κυρίου μακαρία ἡ γῆ», which is the common of martyrs, and a Μεγαλυνάριον and a Κάθισμα; none of those is taken here.

english.text: As lambs chosen for holiness by the Saviour, setting out from lands of many kinds, you ran together to the flock of wise Sabbas; whence, being put to death by the cruelty of barbarians, you went up rejoicing to the fold in heaven, as venerable ones and as prizewinners, entreating for our souls.

hymns.text: Τὴν τῶν ὁσίων θεόληπτον συνοδείαν, ταῖς τῶν Μαρτύρων διαλάμπουσαν ἀκτῖσι, πάντες τοῖς ᾄσμασι στεφανώσωμεν, τοὺς τῷ Χριστῷ τυθέντας, οἷάπερ θεῖα σφάγια· αὐτούς γὰρ ὁ Λόγος προσεδέξατο.

source.text: saint.gr — Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος β’, Τήν ἐν πρεσβείαις, on the page of Άγιοι Αββάδες εν τη μονή του Αγίου Σάββα αναιρεθέντες. It is proper to the company: a God-possessed brotherhood of venerable ones shining with the martyrs' rays.

english.text: Let us all crown with songs the God-possessed company of the venerable, shining with the rays of the martyrs, who were offered up to Christ as divine victims; for the Word himself received them.

hymns.text: Земных и тленных наслаждение/ презревше яве, преблаженнии,/ пустынное житие изволивше,/ мира же краснейшее, и пищи временный возненавидевше,/ отонудуже сподобистеся Небеснаго Царствия,/ с лики мученик и постник веселящеся./ Темже, чтуще память вашу,/ вопием вам прилежно:/ от бед нас, отцы, избавите.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 20 марта ст. ст., «Кондак преподобных отец, во обители святаго Саввы убиенных», глас 4

english.text: Having plainly despised the enjoyment of earthly and corruptible things, most blessed ones, and having chosen the life of the wilderness, and hated the fairest things of the world and its passing food, thereby were you counted worthy of the heavenly Kingdom, rejoicing with the choirs of martyrs and of ascetics. Therefore, honouring your memory, we cry to you earnestly: deliver us from troubles, O fathers.
